items.q: the people that went through the band during your years there were -- you were there, part of that section, with Frank (Jones), Ernie Wilkins, Frank Foster and Charlie Bokes

ctx.x: Do the people you work with -- the people that went through the band during your years there were -- you were there, part of that section, with Frank (Jones), Ernie Wilkins, Frank Foster and Charlie Bokes (PHONETIC), and you did quite a bit of clarinet playing there and now, there's no clarinets. When I went up to see the Basie Band a couple of months ago at Disneyland, I didn't see any clarinets.
There's no clarinet on the stand.
